edits.current: Format 2276 is annual and carries one record per beneficiary to whom work or pension income was paid or credited in account in the tax year (Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1). A beneficiary whose withholding was nil still gets a record, with zero in every value numeral (par. 2 - see 'Employee whose withholding was nil'). Where no work or pension income was paid or credited in account to any person in the tax year there is no beneficiary and payroll generates no Format 2276 record; the format has no nil record. A monthly nil period does not arise for this return: every amount is an annual accumulation by payment date.

edits.current: Not payroll income. Fees paid to a non-executive director who holds no employment contract are not generated by the payroll engine, and payroll contributes nothing to the record. Res. 227 par. 5 governs their reporting: where the fee was withheld under ET art. 383 it is reported in Format 2276 numeral 9 (fees) by the employer's tax function, outside payroll; where art. 383 did not apply it is reported in the ordinary payments-and-withholdings formats instead (see 'Natural person paid work income OUTSIDE an employment relationship' below).

edits.current: Numerals 30 and 31 are not payroll figures: Colombian employment income carries no VAT. They are relevant only where the beneficiary is a VAT-responsible contractor paid under the ET art. 383 table, are populated by the employer's tax function outside payroll, and are written as zero on every employee record (Res. 227 para. 2).
